title: Default Privileges
summary: ALTER DEFAULT PRIVILEGES changes future objects only, so existing tables, sequences, and functions still need explicit repair.
learning_objectives: Use ALTER DEFAULT PRIVILEGES for future object grants.
Identify existing objects that default privileges did not touch.
Document the owning role and target schema for a default privilege rule.
reflection_prompts: Which permission would you remove first if this role were leaked?
What SQL evidence would you attach to an access review?
